tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Start sending signed event POSTs (incoming messages, handoffs, deals) to a public https URL of the business backend. Returns the signing secret once. Every delivery is a POST with X-ReplyBuddy-Event, X-ReplyBuddy-Delivery and X-ReplyBuddy-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the secret>. Body: {id, type, api_version, created_at, agent_id, data}; id is the event id, the same for every endpoint and retry: dedupe on it. X-ReplyBuddy-Delivery is a separate delivery id, one per event and endpoint. data by type: message.received {conversation_id, message}; conversation.handoff_requested {conversation_id, reason}; deal.created and deal.updated {deal}; deal.moved {deal, from_stage_id, moved_by}; deal.deleted {deal_id}; webhook.test {endpoint_id}. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds: a timeout, a 3xx (redirects are not followed) or any other status is a failure. A failed delivery gets 8 attempts over about 28 hours; an endpoint whose deliveries keep failing is disabled. The URL cannot be changed later.

events.description: Events to deliver; message.received covers incoming client messages only.

url.description: Public https URL; it cannot be changed later.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read how one part of ReplyBuddy works, in detail: concepts, rules, limits and which tools do what. Sections: analytics, api-keys, broadcasts, contacts, crm, custom-api-skills, data-handling, errors-and-limits, marketing, testing, tools, webhooks, workspace-model. A link to <name>.md inside a guide is the section <name>.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List the deliveries of one webhook endpoint for the last 30 days: status, attempts, last HTTP status and error, and the exact payload sent.

tools.name: list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints that receive signed event POSTs. Signing secrets are never listed.

tools.name: update_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Change the events, description or enabled flag of a webhook endpoint; the URL cannot change. enabled=true turns a disabled endpoint back on and resumes its pending deliveries.
